conclusion: The current stock modeled-filling route is pressure-aware and is a viable native research path for boosted mass, but its pressure truth is blocked upstream. In canonical AC1S, modeled Pvdk is ambient minus an unsigned air-cleaner decrement (all zero stock), integrated manifold pressure is bounded by that modeled Pvdk minus 51 counts, and the sensor-derived alternative cannot produce above-ambient pressure through the unsigned-load differential conversion. S_EISY_TURBO changes request/control normalization, not the selected actual-filling pressure. Recovering a MAF-to-NN bridge is not prerequisite to investigating this native pressure/model route; no statement here validates that route for operation.

critical_corrections.claim: 01802fc8 itself is capped at 1.0 by K_PVDKPNRFV_MX
critical_corrections.result: False for the recovered producer. 001038e4 has only u16 saturation; K_PVDKPNRFV_MX=4000 is a local min in consumer 000c4100 before Q14->Q15 doubling. 01802fca remains stock-active via S_FTPVDKPN=01 and sees uncapped 01802fc8. Its actual-inflow consumer 00443824 can therefore respond above unity independently of S_EISY_TURBO.

critical_corrections.claim: Hardcoded standard-pressure normalization causes an altitude+boost bias
critical_corrections.result: Not established; P/Pstandard is a dimensionless density normalization, whereas P/Pambient is a different quantity. Feeding genuine absolute pressure into P/Pstandard preserves altitude dependence; replacing the divisor with ambient would erase part of that dependence unless all consumers were redesigned. Ambient ratio already appears explicitly in residual-pressure model and pressure reconstruction. The pressure-input provenance, not a constant reference alone, is the demonstrated defect. Other model/calibration errors remain unvalidated.

critical_corrections.claim: 0x654d is exactly 1013.25 hPa and 257/121 exactly equals the ratio of published XDF scales
critical_corrections.result: Arithmetic correction: 0x654d=25933; at nominal 0.0390625 hPa/count it is 1013.0078125 hPa, not 1013.25. 257/121*0.0390625=0.08296745867768594, not rounded XDF 0.082918. c_amp_ref canonical bytes 2fb9=12217. Preserve raw equations and do not claim exact equality between rounded/documentary scales.

The recovered 6b76 is the pressure subsequently subtracted from 6ac2; fresh-air pressure difference for 6b9a is max(6ac2-6b76,0). 6b74 is max(Pstandard-6b6c,0). Calling 6b76 itself fresh-air partial pressure reverses the role.

critical_corrections.claim: Absolute MAP substitution into 2b3c/2b3e is sufficient to yield boosted Ps
critical_corrections.result: No: these are unsigned differential-code inputs. 00434c48 LHZ followed by positive scaling cannot yield a negative differential at 694e/6950. An absolute value written there is still subtracted from ambient downstream; a two-complement negative value saturates positive. A software interface/domain change upstream of actual-pressure selection is required, not just changing the transfer endpoints.
